scope: Exactly two already independently reviewed exact-rational fixed HX models, default #4663 c418deeb670a1e5a52970e3a8b10fe95c75618a1 and second-model local accepted receipt58e51d9df714ef13f364b0008e27df0f0b5114ccdaf33f0f1ef35d786c917d86; no arbitrary models or production/remote changes.
canonicalization: JSON sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=True, UTF8, reject duplicate keys and NaN/Inf numeric constants; exact rational strings fixed as registered, not coerced from floats
model_digest: SHA256 of canonical exact_params dictionary, compared with exactly two registered model entries
receipt_digest: SHA256 canonical whole root payload excluding only elapsed_seconds, or coefficients excluding only precompute_seconds; all other fields bound. Registry pins the two previously reviewed non-timing digests and source identities. Contract binds both receipt digests to model_digest.

fixed_claims.runtime_premises: trusted CPython IEEE binary64 RN ties-even; no fenv mutation/reassociation/FMA or hostile constants

emission: Deterministic generator checks exact contract fields/registered values/root+coefficient identities/statuses/finiteness. Runtime gets MODEL_DIGEST, EXACT_PARAMETERS, CONTRACT_SHA256, versions and correct label. Companion checker compares runtime bytes with deterministic rendering from validated bundle; no import of an unvalidated runtime.
positive_protocol: Both model bundles; seven frozen assets each from existing evidence plus endpoints; source equity operation AST unchanged, old/new outputs bit-identical; rigorous local Green/A7 checks; root+precompute reproduction in copies with non-timing identity checks.
trust: Digest is identity binding, not a signature or adversarial-artifact security guarantee. Registry and producer/source code remain trusted. Pins certify only these existing artifacts; new parameters or proof implementations require separate validation and registration.
limits: 2 positive models and19 planned negative controls only; no benchmark/sweep, each subprocess120s; reuse existing FLINT venv; independent pre/post review. Preserve previous label failure and proof-document correction evidence in original directories and link them.
